commit_message: Rebase ADR0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the audited ADR0126 Timeline foundation onto the exact current-main baseline including the newly proposed ADR0154 documentation. ADR0126 continues to persist Animation Set + stable MotionSlotId identity and does not duplicate ADR0154's future target-aware route policy.

This establishes the dependency-neutral Timeline clock/schedule/player, stable Timeline IDs and persistence, deterministic compilation/evaluation, transactional authoring service, capability/CLI/MCP integration, and shared camera-selection override groundwork.

The PR remains Draft while schema/Event semantics, production runtime composition, Project Rust control, the dedicated Sequencer workspace, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation continue.
